name: High Protein muesli
ingredients_raw: Whole Grains (48%) (Rolled Oats, Ragi Flakes, Jowar Flakes, Brown Rice Flakes, Quinoa Flakes); Protein Blend (23%) (Texturized Soy Protein, Soy Protein Isolate); Dehydrated Fruits and Fruit Granulates (14%) (100% Natural Strawberry Powder, Raisin, Cranberry, Apricot); Nuts & Seeds (8%) (Almonds, Pumpkin Seeds, Chia Seeds); Organic Jaggery, Dates, Rice Bran Oil, Himalayan Pink Salt. CONTAINS ADDED NATURAL FLAVOURS: Strawberry & Cranberry. Allergen Information: Contains Oats, Soy & Nuts. Processed and packed in a facility that also processes dairy products (Whey Protein).
